correctness.rationale: Restrict the defining quartic to any projective line, viewing the coordinates as four binary linear forms. After discarding zero forms and grouping proportional forms, the fourth powers of the distinct forms are linearly independent by a Vandermonde minor (choose a chart in which all their first coefficients are nonzero). Each proportionality group must therefore have at least two coordinates for cancellation, and a projective line requires at least two independent forms. This forces the stated pair families, with ratios the four odd powers of ζ₈. Same-family lines sharing a ratio meet, giving at most four per family and at most twelve in total. An independent exact modular-phase consistency test on the union of two matchings, followed by exhaustive graph clique recursion, yielded 128 twelve-line sets. The Hessian determinant defines the four coordinate planes, hence projective automorphisms are monomial with equal fourth powers on the diagonal. The independent census uses a coordinate 4-cycle, one adjacent transposition, and multiplication of one coordinate by i; these generate the group of order 1536, and its two orbit sizes 32 and 96 give stabilizers 48 and 16. The Galois maps k=1,3,5,7 fix 128,16,128,16 systems, respectively; the orbit counts are sixteen singletons and 56 doubletons. A primitive eighth-root ratio forces the field of an individual line to be K. The reduced union descends to the fixed field of its stabilizer by Galois descent of its homogeneous ideal. The involution k=5 fixes exactly Q(i) as a field, so all 128 systems are defined there; sixteen are rational and the other 112 have minimal field Q(i).
residual_risks: The replay checks only the size-twelve systems, not every smaller inclusion-maximal system. The group is the full geometric projective group, not the possibly larger group of abstract automorphisms of the surface. Arithmetic counts are for the all-plus rational form and for unordered reduced unions.

evidence: Andria et al. prove the maximum 3d in degree d except d=3,5 and give a construction for even d. Degtyarev and Rams classify whole K3-quartic line configurations with at least 49 lines and report a lower bound on the number of configurations with 48 lines. Veniani studies symmetries of quartics with many lines, treating 48 as the Fermat baseline.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Existence and an upper bound cover exactly the maximum size. Whole-surface line configurations and symmetry results are not the census or symmetry action on the size-twelve subsets.

evidence: The known line equations and congruences define the finite graph explicitly. The degree-four maximum theorem guarantees at least one maximum set, and the existing exact pair histogram is a different level of the graph. The inspected literature does not give fixed-system counts for the Q-model.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The known graph makes the census computable but does not supply it as a table lookup or parameter substitution: compatible size-twelve subsets must be exhausted, and then partitioned under two different group actions. Galois stability of every configuration over Q(i), despite no individual line descending there, is not a consequence of a geometric orbit size.

evidence: These skew sets are size-twelve independent sets of the line-intersection graph, equivalently size-twelve cliques in its complement; all are maximum, not merely inclusion-maximal. The indexed graph record uses the same all-plus equation over C and lists the exact cross-family congruences. Andria et al. use a signed Fermat equation over C.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The graph exactly encodes geometric skewness, and complex projective changes of signs preserve the geometric census. A sign change using primitive eighth roots need not be defined over Q, so arithmetic Galois orbit statements cannot be transferred by that geometric identification alone.

value.rationale: This is the natural maximum-cardinality packing on a classical K3 surface, not an arbitrary subset size. The exact geometric orbit split distinguishes configurations that are not projectively equivalent, while the arithmetic counts answer which unions can be used over Q or Q(i) even though their components cannot individually be used there. A researcher choosing a rational maximum system or a representative of each geometric type needs more than the known maximum size or pair spectrum.
residual_risks: Value is the complete finite classification for this surface and rational model, not a general theorem for other quartics or twists.
